description: Send a photo of a slot machine on a casino floor (a public https image URL, or base64). SlotMaps identifies the machine, reads its visible state (meters, coins, pigs, counters) and says whether it's worth playing right now and why. $1.99 per photo, paid through Stripe machine payments.

image_base64.description: The photo as base64, if there's no URL

image_url.description: Public https URL of the photo

mime_type.description: image/jpeg or image/png when sending base64

name: read_machine_photo
title: Read a photo of a slot machine
